Results.ReviewText:
After a long affair with propane, I have returned to charcoal....and I love it.

This grill is feature packed, and easy to use.  The coal baskets make organizing heat zones simple, and I love the ash catch can.  It is much easier and safer than the frisbee shaped dish on my old Weber.

I like that the Master Touch is about 3" taller, it sits between the gas grill and charcoal grill height.  The improved lid holder is nice too.  I like that it acts as a wind block.  I get quite the breeze in my back yard sometimes.

I am a satisfied customer.
Results.Title: Winner winner, cookout for dinner!

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love this grill! After researching several charcoal grills, l decided to go with the tried and true Weber Master-Touch. Easy to assemble; easy to use; easy to clean. I made the perfect grilled steaks & corn on the cob for Father's Day with two chimneys full of charcoal and some hickory wood for a little smoky flavor. The fire lasted a long time and the grill retained its heat. We look forward to using the grill more and in all kinds of weather! Love the beautiful striking Ocean Blue color as well!
Results.Title: Just As I Imagined!

Results.ReviewText: I have used my new grill to make pulled pork, chicken wings, burgers, corn, brats, and even smoked trout! I switched from my first grill(propane) and it is by far the best grill I have ever used. I added a bbq gasket around the lid on mine, but even before doing this temperature control has been very easy. I love the handle hooks, rolling lid holder, small footprint on my patio, and how easy it is to move around. I highly recommend this grill. My only criticism is that I think the thermometer placement would be better by the lid damper, but I typically use my own thermometer anyway. I never do reviews, so the fact that I wrote this shows how much I love my grill :)
Results.Title: Amazing grill at a low price :)

Assembly was very straight forward and the instructions were clear. 
The grill is very well designed and is well built. The grates clean up very well and I like the removable center section. There was a small learning curve because I haven't used charcoal to grill with in several decades. Now that I have the hang of it, I will not be going back to a gas grill. My grilled food has never tasted better.  I would strongly recommend purchasing a charcoal chimney. It get the charcoal ready in about 25 minutes.

Results.ReviewText: I have used a Weber charcoal grill for 40 years. Always happy with it. This is a new grill with a sear plate. I really like the sear grate.
Results.Title: Long time user.

Results.ReviewText:
I currently have a Weber Spirit II E-210 which I've had for 3+ yrs and love it. I've wanted a Weber kettle ever since I saw a demo of a turkey being Q'd some 40+ yrs ago (the taste was amazing) so I finally sprung for the 22" Master Touch 2.5 months ago. Why I didn't do this years ago is beyond me. I've been a "gas" griller for the last 30+ years so it's been a learning experience transitioning to charcoal. Trying different brands of charcoal including hardwood lump, using different types of wood chips for smoking, indirect and direct grilling, wow it's a lot to learn. I've had a couple of grill sessions with the kettle that didn't turn out so well but I've had many more successes. I am so looking forward to smoking a turkey on my kettle. Although charcoal does add another level of flavor gas can't, my E-210 is not going anywhere. There have been a couple times since buying the kettle I'm glad I had it.

I't has been wonderful journey learning to grill with charcoal and I look forward to many more rides
Results.Title: 22" Master Touch - Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Best all around grill without breaking the bank Weber master touch well built
Results.Title: Happy griller

Results.ReviewText: Easy setup, easy to clean, great little grill. Highly recommended

Results.Title: Much better than gas.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
